raw_prompt:
Analyze the video keyframe images showing Hindu devotional content and return ONLY a raw JSON classification matching this schema:
{
  "title": "<Concise descriptive title>",
  "summary": "<2-sentence summary of spiritual activity>",
  "category": "Devotion",
  "content_type": "<Ritual|Music|Discourse|Temple|Festival|Unknown>",
  "primary_class": "<Abhishekam|Aarti|Pooja|Archana|Bhajan|Pravachan|Temple Darshan|Festival Procession|Unknown>",
  "secondary_classes": ["<secondary activities>"],
  "deity": "<Deity identified or null>",
  "temple": "<Temple identified or null>",
  "festival": "<Festival identified or null>",
  "language": "<Language spoken or detected>",
  "confidence": <0.0-1.0>,
  "reasoning": "<Reasoning for classification>"
}

Audio Transcript: "Om Namah Shivaya chanting mantras in Sanskrit and Hindi."
Sensor Evidence: "Visual keyframes show altar, deity statue, oil lamp, and flower offerings. Devotional Worship ritual in progress."

parsed_json.title: Hindu Devotional Ritual
parsed_json.summary: A woman is performing a devotional worship (Pooja) with various Hindu deities' statues on an altar.
parsed_json.reasoning: Visual keyframes show an altar with deities' statues, oil lamp, and flower offerings indicating a Hindu devotional worship ritual.
